bird: 双发推力下降。我保持操纵，稳住空速。
mayday: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Cactus 1549，遭遇鸟击，双发失去推力。
power: 应急供电程序已开始，正在尝试重启。
restart: 重启尝试结束，两台发动机都没有恢复推力。
lga: Cactus 1549，拉瓜迪亚可提供紧急返场跑道。报告意图。
left: 保持滑翔空速，左转评估落点。
hold: 保持当前航向，继续判断。
return: 尝试返回拉瓜迪亚，报告余量。
转向拉瓜迪亚，监控能量。
assess: 评估返场，比较其他区域。
我继续操纵，评估转弯和对正余量。
lga-low: 返场余量不足，转弯和对正还要消耗高度。
lga-margin: 返场余量有限，仍需转弯对正。
lga-reachable: 返场仍有预计余量。继续注意空速。
alternatives: Cactus 1549，也可评估泰特伯勒。报告意图。
river: 将河面作为首要备选，转向河道方向。
转向河道，等待最后决定。
hold-option: 暂不承诺，延续当前指令。
继续当前指令。高度仍在下降。
teb: 评估泰特伯勒，尝试转向那个方向。
teb-low: 泰特伯勒余量不足，继续比较水面。
commit: 确认水上迫降。我来操纵。
你操纵，我监控空速和高度。
hudson: 收到，正在通知河上救援。
hudson-unable: Cactus 1549，无法返回。准备在哈德逊河迫降。
收到，正在通知河上救援。
config: 起落架保持收起，按能量准备襟翼二。
gear: 起落架仍在放出。水上迫降应保持收轮。
flaps: 襟翼二到位，起落架保持收起。
speed: 空速偏低，减小后拉，保持能量。
river-established: 已建立顺河航迹。继续观察前方水面。
shore: 前方靠近河岸，注意横向修正。
brace: 请做好防冲击准备。防冲击！
evacuate: 撤离！使用可用出口离开飞机，穿好救生衣。
rescue: 救援船正在接近，保持联络。
closing: 飞机保持漂浮，救援接应正在进行。

bird: Both engines are losing thrust. I have control. Maintaining airspeed.
mayday: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Cactus fifteen forty-nine. Bird strike. Lost thrust in both engines.
power: Emergency power sequence started. Attempting a relight.
restart: Relight attempt complete. No thrust recovered on either engine.
lga: Cactus fifteen forty-nine, LaGuardia is available for an emergency return. Say intentions.
left: Maintain glide speed. Turn left and assess landing areas.
hold: Hold this heading while we assess.
return: Try returning to LaGuardia. Report our margin.
Turning toward LaGuardia. Monitoring our energy.
assess: Assess the return and compare other areas.
I will keep flying and assess the turn and alignment margins.
lga-low: The return margin is insufficient. Turning and aligning will cost more height.
lga-margin: The return margin is small. We still need to turn and align.
lga-reachable: There is still an estimated return margin. Watch the airspeed.
alternatives: Cactus fifteen forty-nine, Teterboro is another option to assess. Say intentions.
river: Prioritize the river option. Turn toward it.
Turning toward the river. Awaiting your final decision.
hold-option: No commitment yet. Continue the current instruction.
Continuing. We are still losing altitude.
teb: Assess Teterboro and turn toward it.
teb-low: Teterboro has insufficient margin. Consider the water option.
commit: We are committing to a water landing. I have control.
You have control. I will monitor airspeed and altitude.
hudson: Cactus fifteen forty-nine. Preparing to ditch in the Hudson.
Roger. Alerting rescue services on the river.
hudson-unable: Cactus fifteen forty-nine. Unable to return. Preparing to ditch in the Hudson.
Roger. Alerting rescue services on the river.
early: I have control. Continuing as practice.
config: Keep the gear up. Prepare flaps two as energy permits.
gear: The gear is extended. Keep it up for ditching.
flaps: Flaps two set. Gear remains up.
speed: Airspeed low. Ease the back pressure and preserve energy.
river-established: Established along the river. Keep watching the water ahead.
shore: We are approaching the riverbank. Correct the track.
evacuate: Evacuate! Use the available exits. Put on your life vests.
rescue: Rescue boats are approaching. Remain on frequency.
closing: The aircraft remains afloat. Rescue assistance is under way.
